title: Tidemark Watch Bell
source: Independently authored 25-component graph from an empty workspace; no completed designs or asset fixtures used.

iterations.critique: Bronze too polished; automatic detail view concentrated on the mount rather than the cavity.

Rougher, slightly darker bronze and weathered oak; lower detail view exposes hollow mouth and suspended clapper. Silhouette reads at gameplay distance. Source connections remain plausible in sampled motion.

weaknesses: The cast bronze surface remains uniformly smooth; subtle tool marks and richer local wear are absent.
The silhouette is deliberately restrained and rotationally regular; it is recognizable but does not establish AAA art quality.
Only one sampled motion pose is retained; these views are not an exhaustive animation or collision review.
